content.short: Mint Kudos enables anyone to mint non-transferrable NFTs on Polygon to record contributions.
content.description: Mint Kudos is a DAO achievement tool that lets anyone mint Kudos tokens—non-transferable NFTs—to recognize community members' contributions. It is deployed on Polygon and was founded in 2022 by Catherine Chang and Kei Yoshikoshi. Notable users include Women Build Web3 and Developer DAO. Because the NFTs are non-transferable, they cannot be bought, sold, or traded. Mint Kudos is a free, no-code solution that also offers an API for scalable minting and distribution of these achievement-based NFTs.
